_comment: Curated ATS boards -- one slug per employer per provider, and every row must answer live. Probe before adding; see AGENTS.md section 8b. One exception to "slug is the employer": for source `synology` the slug is a LOCATION id (`HQ`, the only one), because Synology publishes its own API rather than an ATS board -- see services/jobs/synology.py, and for source `line` the slug is the careers SITE (`linecorp`, the only one): LINE serves one site covering 13 separate employers, so a posting's company comes off the posting and this row's `company` is only a fallback -- see services/jobs/line.py.
_missing: Google/Alphabet is NOT reachable and must not be added. Checked 2026-11-13: slugs google, googlellc, googleinc and alphabet all 404 on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby and 422 on Workday; the old careers.google.com v2/v3 JSON APIs now 404. The careers results page IS server-rendered (20 postings inline) but google.com/robots.txt disallows every page= variant for User-agent:*, capping a compliant reader at those 20 -- and there is no JobPosting JSON-LD on the results or detail pages and no careers sitemap, so there is no stable contract to parse anyway. No free aggregator is both stocked and licensed: keyless ones (Arbeitnow, Jobicy, Himalayas, Remotive) carry no Google, The Muse API is gone, and Adzuna/Jooble terms forbid commercial republication. Full reasoning in AGENTS.md section 8b. BEWARE the SmartRecruiters trap: /v1/companies/<slug>/postings returns 200 with totalFound 0 for ANY slug, nonsense ones included, so a 200 there proves nothing; only a non-empty payload does. Alphabet subsidiaries waymo and wing ARE carried (added 2026-11-13) as the nearest reachable thing to Google. Note that Waymo's senior ML roles are dropped by the deny_always needle 'driver' -- the Waymo Driver is a product, not a delivery job -- see AGENTS.md section 8b.
_added_2026_11_15: Microsoft IS reachable, on Greenhouse token `microsoftcorporation` (77 postings, every one naming Microsoft AI in its description). That board is Microsoft AI (MAI) only, NOT all of Microsoft: the main careers site moved to Eightfold (jobs.careers.microsoft.com redirects to apply.careers.microsoft.com / app.eightfold.ai), which is not a provider we read, so the several thousand postings there are not carried. Do not read the 77 as Microsoft total coverage. Microsoft has no Workday tenant either -- wd1 and wd5 both 422.
_missing_line: LINE IS carried as of 2026-11-15, by the `line` provider rather than a row under any ATS: every plausible slug 404s on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby, gives the meaningless SmartRecruiters 200/totalFound-0, and 422s on Workday. careers.linecorp.com is a Gatsby site over Strapi whose page-data JSON is readable without a key, and robots.txt disallows only two 2021 paths. COUNTS ARE A TRAP: the list payload carries drafts too -- 306 of 387 are unpublished, so only 81 are live, 53 of them Taipei and 64 in scope. Filter `publish is True` before quoting any number from this source. See services/jobs/line.py and AGENTS.md section 8b.
